items.pos: v. 低價搶標；削價競爭
items.colloc: undercut competitors 削價競爭 | undercut prices 低價賣出
items.distinct: undersell 賤賣 | discount 折扣
ex: They intend to undercut our prices significantly.
他們打算大幅削價以低於我們的價格。
Our company will not undercut the competition.
我們公司不會進行削價競爭。
Suppliers often undercut each other to win contracts.
供應商常互相削價來爭取合約。

items.colloc: cash rebate 現金回饋 | claim a rebate 申請退款
items.distinct: refund 全額退費 | reimbursement 費用報銷
ex: Customers can apply for a mail-in rebate.
顧客可以申請郵寄退款優惠。
The manufacturer offers a rebate on appliances.
製造商提供家電產品的現金回饋。
Check the eligibility for the special rebate.
檢查該項特別折扣的資格條件。

items.colloc: promotional offer 促銷優惠 | promotional budget 促銷預算
items.distinct: advertisement 廣告 | publicity 公關宣傳
ex: The team finalized the new promotional strategy.
團隊定案了新的促銷策略。
All promotional materials are ready for release.
所有促銷文宣都準備好發布了。
We increased the promotional budget this quarter.
我們在本季度增加了促銷預算。

items.colloc: liquidate assets 變賣資產 | liquidate stock 出清庫存
items.distinct: settle 結算 | dissolve 解散
ex: The store must liquidate stock before closing.
商店必須在歇業前出清庫存。
We plan to liquidate assets to pay debts.
我們計畫變賣資產以償還債務。
It is difficult to liquidate these items quickly.
快速變現這些商品相當困難。

items.colloc: government subsidize 政府補助 | heavily subsidized 大幅補貼
items.distinct: finance 資助 | sponsor 贊助
ex: The government will subsidize the transport costs.
政府將會補貼運輸費用。
They subsidize projects that benefit the community.
他們補貼對社區有利的專案。
Many industries are subsidized by local authorities.
許多產業由地方當局給予補貼。

items.colloc: overprice products 商品定價過高 | risk overpricing 定價過高的風險
items.distinct: overcharge 超收費用 | inflate 通膨
ex: It is easy to overprice items during shortages.
缺貨期間很容易將商品定價過高。
Do not overprice the new line of clothing.
不要將新系列服裝定價過高。
The company realized they did overprice goods.
公司意識到他們確實將產品定價過高。

items.colloc: bundled service 組合服務 | bundled software 捆綁軟體
items.distinct: packaged 包裝的 | collective 集體的
ex: They offer a bundled package for customers.
他們為顧客提供組合銷售的套裝。
Bundled products usually cost less than individual.
組合產品通常比單買便宜。
Software is often bundled with new hardware.
軟體常與新硬體一同綑綁銷售。

items.colloc: competitive pricing 具競爭力的定價 | stay competitive 保持競爭力
items.distinct: competent 勝任的 | comparable 可比較的
ex: We must maintain a competitive price strategy.
我們必須維持具競爭力的定價策略。
The market is highly competitive this year.
市場今年的競爭非常激烈。
Our firm offers competitive rates for clients.
本公司為客戶提供具競爭力的費率。

items.colloc: wholesale price 批發價 | wholesale distributor 批發商
items.distinct: retail 零售 | bulk 大量
ex: The firm specializes in wholesale distribution.
該公司專營批發通路。
We buy components at a wholesale price.
我們以批發價購買零組件。
Wholesale orders require a minimum quantity.
批發訂單有最低數量要求。

items.colloc: fixed cost 固定成本 | fixed rate 固定費率
items.distinct: stable 穩定的 | permanent 永久的
ex: The company has high monthly fixed costs.
該公司每月有很高的固定成本。
They prefer a fixed rate for the project.
他們偏好為專案設定固定費率。
We need to determine the fixed pricing.
我們需要確定固定定價。

items.colloc: profit margin 利潤率 | thin margin 微薄利潤
items.distinct: markup 加價 | dividend 股利
ex: We operate on a very thin profit margin.
我們的利潤空間非常微薄。
Improving efficiency will increase the margin.
提升效率將會增加利潤空間。
The sales team focused on high margin products.
銷售團隊聚焦於高利潤產品。

items.pos: n. 負擔能力；價格合適性
items.colloc: ensure affordability 確保價格合理 | cost affordability 成本負擔力
items.distinct: accessibility 可取得性 | availability 可用性
ex: Customers prioritize affordability when shopping.
顧客購物時優先考量價格負擔力。
We aim to improve the product's affordability.
我們致力於提升產品的價格合適性。
The new model focuses on consumer affordability.
新款式聚焦於消費者的負擔能力。
